claims.summary: Observed: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) rebuilds a non-destructive remainder, preserving marker bytes only when the marker has reference syntax; distinguishes transport-only markers from grammatical-subject markers (quoting/grouping or a following relation verb like appears/represents).
claims.disposition: verified_existing. Source L114-144: remainder pushes the marker token only at L129-131 when reference_syntax.is_some(); relation verbs appears (L67) / represents (L82) are in the allowlist. Locked by preserves_quoted_exact_token_reference (tests.rs L1995). 72/72 control_marker tests green at SHA 902a0358.

claims.summary: Likely Snag: first_word_after (L89) uses split_whitespace + per-chunk alnum trim (L92) to find the verb; a multi-word phrase after a marker (e.g. 'represents a specific type of...') might set reference_syntax=None and strip/retain the marker incorrectly.
claims.disposition: verified_existing, contradiction preserved. first_word_after (L89-96) returns the first finite alphanumeric word; allowlist membership is the sole preservation gate. 'represents a specific type of...' -> 'represents' (L82, allowlisted) -> preserved. Only-first-finite-word is intended fail-closed, not a bug. Regressions uses_only_the_first_finite_relation_word (tests L2605) and first_word_after_skips_leading_punctuation_transition (L2635).

claims.summary: Test 1 (Syntax Validation): verify exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199) identifies nested/complex Unicode delimiters (e.g. the CJK corner bracket 「...」 cited at L169) and returns the correct ExactKnownMarkerReferenceContext.
claims.disposition: verified_existing; no uncovered variant. 「」 is source L168 (report says L169; L169 is 『』) in the QuotedExactKnownToken arm; exact_reference_delimiter_syntax is L199-229. Existing tests: preserves_non_ascii_matching_quote_pairs (tests L2342) asserts 「<end_of_turn>」 preserved with quoted_reference_occurrences==1; whitespace variant preserves_quoted_exact_tokens_across_whitespace (L2401); nested CJK stack depth 3 preserves_nested_fullwidth_cjk_reference_stack (L2383).

claims.summary: Test 2 (Grammar Persistence): provide 'marker behaves as a primary signal' and assert scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) preserves the marker based on the first word 'behaves' (cited L70).
claims.disposition: verified_existing. 'behaves' is allowlisted at source L69 (report says L70, off-by-one). Preservation by a leading relation verb is locked by preserves_proxy_relation_phrase (tests L2552, 'functions as...') and uses_only_the_first_finite_relation_word (L2605, 'functions like...' retained / 'acts like...' stripped). The proposed 'behaves' assertion follows from allowlist membership plus these regressions.
